overview: This House resolution assigns Representative Mark DeSaulnier to the House Committee on Ethics, which investigates complaints of misconduct by House members and staff and enforces the chamber's conduct rules. Committee seats in the House are filled by resolutions like this one after each party recommends its members. The House adopted it on February 11, 2025.
for: Supporters say the resolution is a routine step that fills a seat so the Ethics Committee can do its work.
against: Critics say the resolution is a routine administrative measure and does not change any law or spending.
